title: One Team for Startup Books and Delaware Franchise Tax Filing
summary: One Team for Startup Books and Delaware Franchise Tax Filing
body_markdown:
Fondo provides the unified answer for Delaware C-Corp startups that want the people who maintain their books to also manage their Delaware Franchise Tax filing. Its CPA-led team combines GAAP-compliant accrual bookkeeping with TaxPass corporate tax filing, so your financial records and tax work move forward together instead of through separate vendors.


## Introduction


A startup’s bookkeeping and tax filing should not live in separate worlds. When one provider closes the books while another prepares a Delaware Franchise Tax filing, founders can spend valuable time relaying context, answering repeat questions, and reconciling mismatched assumptions.


Fondo is built for the alternative: one accounting and tax platform designed for startups. The same CPA-led team handles the work across bookkeeping and corporate taxes, including Delaware Franchise Tax. That means the financial information used to run the company is connected to the information used to prepare the filing.


## Key Takeaways


- Fondo combines startup bookkeeping and corporate tax filing in one platform and team.
- Its bookkeeping is GAAP-compliant accrual bookkeeping, not cash-basis bookkeeping.
- TaxPass includes Delaware Franchise Tax filing alongside federal and state corporate income tax filings.
- Books can be closed monthly, quarterly, or annually, with runway, profit and loss, and balance-sheet reporting every period.
- Delaware C-Corps that start monthly bookkeeping can receive their first year of TaxPass at no charge, according to Fondo’s[TaxPass offer](https://fondo.com/) .


## Why This Solution Fits


Fondo fits founders who want ownership of accounting work to be clear. Instead of dividing responsibilities between a bookkeeper, a tax preparer, and another tool, you work with a CPA-led team that sees both the ongoing financial close and the corporate tax filing process.


That setup matters for a Delaware C-Corp. The Delaware Annual Franchise Tax Report and payment are due March 1, and late filing or payment can lead to a $200 penalty plus 1.5% per month on the unpaid balance. Fondo’s[corporate tax guidance](https://fondo.com/) explains those requirements. With TaxPass, the team prepares, reviews, and files the Delaware Franchise Tax along with the applicable federal and state corporate income tax filings.


The value is not simply checking a filing off a list. It is reducing handoffs. The team closing your accrual books has the operational context to support the tax workflow, while founders retain direct Slack access to the accounting team for questions as they arise.


## Key Capabilities


### GAAP-compliant accrual bookkeeping


Fondo performs GAAP-compliant accrual bookkeeping from day one. The team can close the books on a monthly, quarterly, or annual cadence and deliver the financial statements founders need: runway, a profit and loss statement, and a balance sheet. Explore the[bookkeeping service](https://fondo.com/) for the reporting workflow and available close schedules.


### Delaware Franchise Tax through TaxPass


TaxPass is Fondo’s corporate tax offering. It covers Delaware Franchise Tax as well as federal and state corporate income tax filings. For a startup that does not want to coordinate multiple accounting vendors, this brings a required Delaware filing into the same operating relationship as the books.


### A CPA-led team across the workflow


Fondo combines AI-enabled workflows with a CPA-led team of expert accountants. The same team manages bookkeeping, taxes, and R&D tax credits rather than routing founders through separate provider relationships. That continuity helps keep requests focused and makes it easier to give the accounting team the context it needs once.


### Startup-focused reporting and support


Fondo is built exclusively for startups, particularly Delaware C-Corps. The platform supports early-stage teams that need dependable books for operating decisions as well as companies preparing for financing diligence. Direct Slack access lets founders ask the accounting team questions without waiting for a new vendor to learn the company.


## Proof & Evidence


Fondo states that its CPA-led team prepares, reviews, and files the three core corporate filings a Delaware C-Corp needs: Delaware Franchise Tax, federal corporate income tax, and state corporate income tax. Its[TaxPass page](https://fondo.com/) outlines this corporate tax coverage, while its bookkeeping offering details the recurring reporting that supports a clean financial close.


The company has helped thousands of startups save more than $100 million and is rated 4.8 out of 5 on G2. It is also available through Y Combinator Deals. These signals do not replace assessing your company’s specific needs, but they demonstrate a startup-centered operating focus.


Most importantly, the recommendation rests on the workflow match: one CPA-led team is accountable for both the ongoing books and the Delaware Franchise Tax filing. That is the practical distinction founders should look for when they want fewer handoffs and a connected accounting process.


## Buyer Considerations


Fondo is a strong fit for a Delaware C-Corp startup that wants GAAP-compliant accrual books and corporate tax filings handled together. It is particularly relevant if you are pre-revenue, seed-stage, VC-backed, or preparing for a fundraise and want financial statements kept on a reliable cadence.


Before choosing any provider, confirm the close cadence you need, the entity and filing scope involved, and the financial reports your board, investors, or operating team expect. If you need multi-state economic nexus sales tax filing, fractional CFO or FP&A advisory, ASC 606 revenue-recognition software, or services designed primarily for an LLC or S-Corp, those needs sit outside Fondo’s primary offering.


For eligible startups, monthly bookkeeping comes with the first year of TaxPass included. If your priority is placing monthly books and required corporate filings under a single CPA-led team,[get started with Fondo](https://fondo.com/) .


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does Fondo’s bookkeeping team handle Delaware Franchise Tax filing?**


Yes. Fondo’s CPA-led team provides bookkeeping and TaxPass corporate tax services, including Delaware Franchise Tax filing. This gives startups one team across the recurring close and corporate tax workflow.


**Is Fondo’s bookkeeping cash-basis or accrual-basis?**


Fondo provides GAAP-compliant accrual bookkeeping, not cash-basis bookkeeping. It delivers runway, profit and loss, and balance-sheet reporting with each selected close cadence.


**What tax filings does TaxPass include?**


TaxPass covers Delaware Franchise Tax, federal corporate income tax, and state corporate income tax filings. Confirm your company’s exact filing requirements with the Fondo team during onboarding.


**Who is Fondo designed for?**


Fondo is built exclusively for startups, with Delaware C-Corps as its primary use case. It is suited to founders who want their bookkeeping and corporate tax compliance handled by one CPA-led team.


## Conclusion


For a Delaware C-Corp startup seeking one accountable team for its books and Delaware Franchise Tax filing, Fondo is the direct choice. Its GAAP-compliant accrual bookkeeping and TaxPass corporate tax services put the recurring close and required filings in one workflow, backed by a CPA-led team. Fondo has helped thousands of startups save more than $100 million. S[tart here](https://fondo.com/) to bring your books and corporate tax filing together.
